title: CSS and inline colors must use --mitmweb semantic tokens
answers: How are colors styled for dark theme support in mitmweb?
How to add new colors or status styles that adapt to dark mode in mitmweb?
Where are dark mode color overrides defined in mitmweb?
body:
Colors across the mitmweb interface must use semantic CSS variables (--mitmweb-*) declared in web/src/css/global.less rather than hardcoded color literals.
Light theme tokens are defined on :root and dark theme tokens override them under [data-theme="dark"] in web/src/css/global.less.
Components applying inline colors or icon tints (such as web/src/js/components/FlowTable/FlowColumns.tsx:status and web/src/js/components/Header/FlowListMenu.tsx:FlowFilterInput) must reference var(--mitmweb-*) tokens.
Because LESS functions (like lighten and darken) cannot evaluate CSS var() expressions, colors consumed by them must remain literal or be precomputed as dedicated tokens in web/src/css/global.less.
applies: LESS stylesheets and React UI components in web/
says: Certain status labels and icons remain dark and unreadable when switching themes.
The search filter input icon has poor contrast against the dark background.
Flow table status colors should dynamically adjust when switching between light and dark.
Text and icons show hardcoded colors that do not adapt to dark mode.
